description: T13 fit-board keybind (design doc §1). Pressing F glides the camera until the whole battlefield fills the part of the window the board can be seen in - the viewport minus the top bar (HUD_Bottom, anchored top), the bottom PhaseStrip, the GameLogPanel and HUD_Right - with a 32px margin on the tighter axis and the board centred on the other. What is drawn is Main.view_offset / view_zoom (BoardRoot's transform); the Camera2D under BoardRoot renders nothing (Main is a CanvasLayer) and is kept as a mirror, its position the board centre once fitted. Shooting phase on co_pretrigger: no modal owns the keyboard there (the Command phase's secondary-mission dialog takes key input). Player path: the real F key through the OS-event pipeline (simulate_key press, held through the glide, then release). Setup: the camera looks at the world origin at 0.3x (view and Camera2D mirror both set), so the board sits in the bottom-right quarter, half off screen. Checks: F is bound to Fit View to Board only and focus_p2_zone is unbound (it used to share F; Main._process polls it every frame and snapped the view onto Player 2's zone at 0.8x for as long as F was down, so a real F press never showed the board - the old scenario drove _input directly through the t13 seam and read the Camera2D mirror, which said 'fitted' while the screen showed Player 2's zone). Tier A: last_camera_fit_action 'board'; Camera2D.position within 8px of the board centre; zoom within 0.02 of the fit zoom computed here from the four HUD panels' rects ((free height - 64) / 2400 at 1920x1080 = 0.3692), and the rendered view_zoom equal to it; pixel_diff before -> after > 10%. Tier B in numbers: SceneRefs.board_screen_rect (the real BoardRoot transform) inside the viewport, touching none of the HUD panels or the reserve rails, its margins inside the free area 32px on the tight axis and equal (within 1px) top/bottom and left/right; the glide (sampled every frame while F is held) passes through at least 3 intermediate zooms, never moves away from the target, and no frame covers more than 40% of the zoom change, the Camera2D mirror following; a mid-glide frame differs from both ends. Holding F again once fitted moves nothing. The scripted fit_view_to_board() lands on the same framing instantly with no glide. With the log hidden (a real click on Hide Log) F re-centres the board in the wider area, still 32px clear and centred.

steps.comment: No modal window owns the keyboard, so a real F reaches Main._input.

steps.script: return KeybindingManager.find_conflict("fit_view_board", KEY_F, false, false, false, false)
steps.comment: No other action shares plain F (focus_p2_zone used to).

steps.script: return int(KeybindingManager.get_binding("focus_p2_zone").get("key", -1))

var b = KeybindingManager.get_binding("fit_view_board")
return int(b.get("key", -1)) == KEY_F and not b.get("shift", true)
main.last_camera_fit_action

# Deliberate offset: the camera looks at the world origin at 0.3x. Set the
# rendered view (view_offset / view_zoom) AND the Camera2D mirror.
var m = tree.current_scene
var vp = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.view_zoom = 0.3
m.view_offset = Vector2(0, 0) - vp / (2.0 * 0.3)
m.update_view_transform()
m.camera.position = Vector2(0, 0)
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(0.3, 0.3)
m.set_meta("t13_samples", [])
return m.camera.position.distance_to(Vector2(SettingsService.get_board_width_px() * 0.5, SettingsService.get_board_height_px() * 0.5))
steps.comment: Starts ~1480 world px from the board centre.

steps.script:

return SceneRefs.board_screen_rect(m).position.distance_to(m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size * 0.5)
steps.comment: The offset is really drawn: the board's top-left corner sits at the screen centre.
Player path: press F (OS-event pipeline) and keep it held while the glide runs - the per-frame focus_p2_zone poll used to hijack exactly this.

steps.script: return not tree.current_scene.is_camera_glide_active()
main.last_camera_fit_action
steps.comment: Tier A.

steps.script: main.camera.position.distance_to(Vector2(SettingsService.get_board_width_px() * 0.5, SettingsService.get_board_height_px() * 0.5))
steps.comment: Tier A: Camera2D.position within 8px of the board centre.

steps.script:
# Tier A: zoom vs the fit zoom computed HERE from the HUD panels' own rects
# (not from Main's helper): free area = viewport minus top bar, phase strip,
# log and right panel; zoom = min((w - 64) / board_w, (h - 64) / board_h).
var m = tree.current_scene
for n in ["HUD_Bottom", "PhaseStrip", "GameLogPanel", "HUD_Right"]:
	if not m.get_node(n).is_visible_in_tree():
		return 999.0
var top = m.get_node("HUD_Bottom").get_global_rect().end.y
var bottom = m.get_node("PhaseStrip").get_global_rect().position.y
var left = m.get_node("GameLogPanel").get_global_rect().end.x
var right = m.get_node("HUD_Right").get_global_rect().position.x
var z = min((right - left - 64.0) / SettingsService.get_board_width_px(), (bottom - top - 64.0) / SettingsService.get_board_height_px())
m.set_meta("t13_expected_zoom", z)
return abs(m.camera.zoom.x - z)
abs(main.view_zoom - main.get_meta("t13_expected_zoom"))
steps.comment: The rendered zoom (BoardRoot's transform), not just the mirror, is the fit zoom.

steps.script: is_equal_approx(main.camera.zoom.x, main.camera.zoom.y)

var m = tree.current_scene
return m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().encloses(SceneRefs.board_screen_rect(m))
steps.comment: Whole board on screen.

steps.script:
# Margins between the drawn board and the free area (HUD panel edges).
var m = tree.current_scene
var board = SceneRefs.board_screen_rect(m)
var top = m.get_node("HUD_Bottom").get_global_rect().end.y
var bottom = m.get_node("PhaseStrip").get_global_rect().position.y
var left = m.get_node("GameLogPanel").get_global_rect().end.x
var right = m.get_node("HUD_Right").get_global_rect().position.x
var ml = board.position.x - left
var mr = right - board.end.x
var mt = board.position.y - top
var mb = bottom - board.end.y
m.set_meta("t13_margins", {"left": ml, "right": mr, "top": mt, "bottom": mb})
return min(min(ml, mr), min(mt, mb))
steps.comment: Every side at least 32px clear (1px tolerance).

steps.script:
var mg = tree.current_scene.get_meta("t13_margins")
return min(min(mg.left, mg.right), min(mg.top, mg.bottom))
steps.comment: ...and exactly 32px on the tight axis: the board fills the area.

steps.script:
var mg = tree.current_scene.get_meta("t13_margins")
return abs(mg.top - mg.bottom)
steps.comment: Uniform: top == bottom.

steps.script:
var mg = tree.current_scene.get_meta("t13_margins")
return abs(mg.left - mg.right)
steps.comment: Uniform: left == right (centred across).
At least 3 frames strictly between the start and fitted zoom (an instant cut has 0).
No frame moves away from the target (no bounce, no snap to Player 2's zone at 0.8x).
No single frame covers more than 40% of the zoom change (an instant cut is 100%).
The Camera2D mirror animates too.
F really was held down (Input) while those frames ran.
Tier A.
Each captured frame of the glide differs from the one before it: start -> mid...
...mid -> mid2...
...mid2 -> end: in-between frames were drawn, not one cut.

steps.script:

m.set_meta("t13_fit_zoom", m.view_zoom)
m.set_meta("t13_fit_offset", m.view_offset)
return m.view_zoom

steps.comment: Hold F again once fitted: nothing may move.

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
return abs(m.view_zoom - m.get_meta("t13_fit_zoom")) + m.view_offset.distance_to(m.get_meta("t13_fit_offset"))

# The scripted fit (other scenarios' setup) lands on the same framing at once.
var m = tree.current_scene
m.view_zoom = 1.5
m.view_offset = Vector2(900, 1700)
m.update_view_transform()
m.last_camera_fit_action = ""
m.fit_view_to_board()
if m.is_camera_glide_active():
	return 999.0
if m.last_camera_fit_action != "board":
	return 998.0
return abs(m.view_zoom - m.get_meta("t13_fit_zoom")) + m.view_offset.distance_to(m.get_meta("t13_fit_offset"))

var m = tree.current_scene
var cx = SceneRefs.board_screen_rect(m).get_center().x
m.set_meta("t13_board_center_x", cx)
return cx
steps.comment: With the log open the board is centred on the free area's middle (x = (340 + 1520) / 2 = 930).
Hide the game log the way a player does; F should then use the room it frees.

steps.script: return tree.current_scene.get_node("GameLogPanel").is_visible_in_tree()
return not tree.current_scene.is_camera_glide_active()

# Log hidden: the free area runs from the window's left edge to HUD_Right.
var m = tree.current_scene
var board = SceneRefs.board_screen_rect(m)
var top = m.get_node("HUD_Bottom").get_global_rect().end.y
var bottom = m.get_node("PhaseStrip").get_global_rect().position.y
var left = 0.0
var right = m.get_node("HUD_Right").get_global_rect().position.x
var ml = board.position.x - left
var mr = right - board.end.x
var mt = board.position.y - top
var mb = bottom - board.end.y
if min(min(ml, mr), min(mt, mb)) < 31.0:
	return 999.0
return abs(ml - mr) + abs(mt - mb)
steps.comment: Still 32px clear and centred, now in the wider area.

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
return float(m.get_meta("t13_board_center_x")) - SceneRefs.board_screen_rect(m).get_center().x
steps.comment: The board moved left into the room the log gave back (centre 930 -> 760).
